featured.title: Local LLM Inference & Performance Evaluation Lab
highlights: Configured and benchmarked local inference pipelines for large language models (including Qwen3.8-27B) across GPU and constrained CPU execution paths.

Engineered a resource-constrained CPU inference configuration using AVX2 instruction passthrough, explicit OpenMP thread binding, and custom runtime settings to optimize execution under strict memory limits.
Profiled throughput, concurrency, and resource utilization across local and hosted inference providers to define latency-, privacy-, and cost-based workload routing criteria.

featured.title: Personal AI Automation & Orchestration Platform
highlights: Architected a modular automation platform combining LLM tool execution, browser automation, scheduled job pipelines, and semantic memory.
Automated recurring workflows for technical research, software-engineering market tracking, and media/trend analysis.
Integrated local Ollama models with hosted OpenRouter APIs to dynamically balance latency, reliability, privacy, and inference cost across heterogeneous workloads.

featured.title: Self-Hosted Linux Infrastructure & Reliability Homelab
highlights: Built and maintained a self-hosted Linux environment for containerized application deployment, service monitoring, and failure recovery.
Implemented an automated 3-2-1 backup strategy alongside scheduled patching and restart procedures to enforce high availability.
